AWS Cognito: user attribute permissions and immutable signup
AWS Cognito: update app client settings

steps: Inspect the complete user-pool schema, self-signup policy and every app-client detail; an omitted WriteAttributes list must not be read as an empty allowlist.

Review each authorization-like custom claim, including plan, all client write permissions and any IdP attribute mapping; configure explicit least-privilege write allowlists while preserving required signup and profile fields.
Treat an immutable custom claim as potentially self-supplied during signup; separately reassert existing claim values through a trusted administrator or use server-controlled authorization data.
Recollect the pool and rerun aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_authorization_attributes; resolve missing or partial facts before claiming PASS.
new.summary: Give each app client an explicit WriteAttributes allowlist excluding authorization-like custom claims, including plan, then validate self-signup, federation mappings, and existing claim provenance before trusting the pool.
